data.audit_policy: Audit the deposited SSBOND endpoint pool in chainA/model0: select the SG atom of each distinct annotated cysteine endpoint and measure Euclidean distances in the uploaded coordinates. Endpoints refer to source residue numbers/insertion codes, not atom serials, CA indices or sequence offsets. Symmetry code1555 is the identity; no periodic image or assembly expansion is required for this supplied scope. The declared screening band is1.8<=distance<=2.3angstrom, inclusive. Report every annotated pair and any additional unordered pair within the same endpoint pool falling in that band. Additional-pair IDs use ascending numeric residue order as A:left|A:right. Keep unannotated and annotated relationships distinct; do not infer a bond merely from proximity.
data.scientific_scope: Historical deposited crambin coordinate/annotation consistency audit only. SSBOND annotations and proximity are model evidence, not independent proof of covalent chemistry, in-solution redox state, biological function or causal dynamics. The numeric band is a declared audit rule, not a universal bond law.

source_provenance.projection: All original atomic coordinates, connectivity and annotation endpoints are unchanged. Only columns74–78 of SSBOND records (precomputed bond-length summaries) are blanked to prevent copying the requested geometric results. Original raw snapshot retained separately; no new structure or altered observation is claimed.
source_provenance.read_scope: Official SSBOND residue/symmetry/distance fixed-column definitions, alternate-linkage limitation and identity-symmetry convention; original RCSB1CRN deposited file.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
